recipes.title: Chinese melon and pork
recipes.description: 廣東老火湯 - Cantonese fuzzy melon (節瓜) and pork bone soup (from huafoodcrafter).
ingredients: 節瓜 / Fuzzy melon (hairy gourd) - pick the straight-bodied ones, not too big
筒骨 / Pork tube bone, 1 catty
瑤柱 / Dried scallop (conpoy), a few
冬菇 / Dried shiitake mushroom, a few
steps: Peel and chop the fuzzy melon; blanch the pork tube bone.
Add the pork bone, fuzzy melon, dried scallops, shiitake mushrooms, ginger slices, dried tangerine peel, and honey dates to the pot.
Turn to low heat and simmer for about 1.5 hours (转细火煲佢个半钟).
